## Direct protocol smoke check

Run "'`python3 smoke.py` from this directory. It initializes an MCP session, l
ists tools, and calls add(2,3) three times, asserting no tool error and structuredContent.sum == 5. This is a deterministic protoc
ol/tool check; it does not substitute for a completed hosted suite or measure model behavior. The actual text content is JSON (`{\
"sum\": 5}`), so the hosted case'\"'s expectedOutput \"'`5` may have comparison semantics that require inspection after launch. Se
e direct-smoke-results.json for complete request/response evidence.\nMD'", "aggregated_output": "", "exit_code": null, "status": "
